description: Structural metadata for traces.csv, describing how the trace data set was organized and captured.
note_on_trial_count: This manifest describes the compact representative sample of trials actually shipped in inputs/traces.csv, not the full 64-trial sweep referenced in the original data-collection run. The shipped sample was selected to cover a variety of Hamming weights and bit positions while keeping the file small.

public_operand.note: Held constant across every trial in traces.csv.

cycle_index_range.description: Each trial records 10 consecutive cycles relative to the cycle 'start' was sampled (cycle_index 0), covering the full 8-cycle active sequence (cycle_index 1-8) plus one idle cycle before and after.

secret_operand_sampling.description: Sampled secret_operand values were selected from the full 8-bit range to represent a variety of bit patterns and Hamming weights, rather than an exhaustive sweep of all 256 possible byte values. The full reference data-collection run covers 64 of 256 possible values at a fixed stride; this manifest accompanies a smaller representative subset of those trials shipped in traces.csv for compactness.

fields.name: trial_id
fields.description: Identifier for the transaction this row belongs to. All rows sharing a trial_id belong to the same trial and the same secret_operand value.

fields.name: secret_operand
fields.description: The 8-bit multiplicand value used for this trial. Constant across all rows of the same trial.

fields.name: cycle_index
fields.description: Cycle position relative to the cycle on which 'start' was sampled for this trial.

fields.name: mul_en
fields.description: Value of the mul_en output observed on this cycle.

fields.name: done
fields.description: Value of the done output observed on this cycle.
